If a task edits code or docs, run `spec-dna context <files>` once first. Before a commit, run `spec-dna check`. <!-- spec-dna v0.5.0 h:2672a2e523e57007 -->

Model team: opus builds. The advisor (fable) gives advice and writes no code. `checker` (opus) tests finished work. `Explore` (haiku) searches. Consult the advisor before you choose an approach, before you say that a task is done, and when the same error occurs twice. Each consult sends the whole context at the advisor price, so consult before the context grows large. If the advisor tool is missing, fails or declines, brief `fallback-advisor`. Run `checker` before you say that a task is done. A trivial task needs only the one command that proves it. Send a search that needs more than one command, and a docs search, to `Explore`. Run a one-command search yourself. Give a subagent that writes code or reviews work the model `sonnet` or `opus`, not `haiku`. For a small task that fits in this session, use no subagent. If a file disagrees with the advice, tell the advisor in a second consult. <!-- spec-dna harness v0.5.0 h:33ba1720152655c9 -->
